{{Top|leg}}
The '''telesponder''' was a communications device incorporated on [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]. It automatically transmitted a ship's [[ID profile|identification profile]] in reply to signals broadcast by [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]] and other military or civil authorities.

Many individuals, including [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Spy/Legends|spies]], would have multiple false telesponders installed on their ships. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had numerous false telesponder profiles for the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
